text:
### Summary
- Adds `database_url = os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]` to `main()` in `app/main.py`.
- Because it uses indexing rather than `.get()`, the service now refuses to start when `DATABASE_URL` is unset. Every environment that runs `main()` (local, CI, containers, each deployed stage) must define it.

### Risks
- **The value is never used (`app/main.py`, new line 82).** `database_url` is assigned, then nothing reads it. It is not passed to `make_server(host, port, version)` on the next lines of the diff. The title says the URL is read "from the environment", but nothing appears to consume it. Either a follow-up change is missing, or the code that connects to the database still gets its URL somewhere else, perhaps hard-coded or from a different variable. A linter running pyflakes/ruff `F841` (unused local variable) may fail CI on this line.
- **Startup now requires the variable (`app/main.py:82`).** `os.environ["DATABASE_URL"]` raises a bare `KeyError: 'DATABASE_URL'` when the variable is missing. Failing fast is reasonable if the database is mandatory. The cost is that any environment without the variable (developer machines, CI test jobs, smoke tests, existing deployments) will crash on start once this is deployed. The traceback also does not explain what to set. The other settings (`HOST`, `PORT`, `APP_VERSION`) all have defaults, so this one behaves differently from them.
- **Possible secret exposure later.** Database URLs usually contain credentials. Nothing in this diff logs or prints the value, but if a later change passes it into logging or into an error message, the password would leak. This is worth checking when the value gets wired up.

### Questions
- Where is `database_url` meant to be used? Is a change to `make_server` or a database client missing from this PR?
- Is a missing `DATABASE_URL` meant to be fatal? If so, should it exit with a clear message instead of a `KeyError` traceback?
- Do the Terraform task or container definitions and the GitHub Actions workflows that start the app already set `DATABASE_URL`? Are they updated in this PR or in another one?

### Not verified
- Whether `DATABASE_URL` is set in every deployed environment and CI job. If it is missing anywhere, the service will fail at startup there.
- How the value is supplied: secret manager, plain environment variable in Terraform, or a workflow secret. This matters for whether credentials end up in Terraform state or workflow logs.
- Whether the rest of `main.py`, or modules not shown in the diff, already read `DATABASE_URL` or connect to a database by another path.
- Whether CI linting flags the unused variable.
title: Read the database URL from the environment
